difficulty_reason: The authors control the size-conditioning cost with a subexponential arithmetic local estimate and truncate degree mass to obtain conditioned random-walk bridge concentration, proving the width bound without higher moments. They then transfer to uniform labeled degree-sequence trees through the explicit Foata–Fuchs bijection and couple sampling without replacement to long biased-coin runs, proving superlogarithmic height. The complete joint construction and both authored proof branches go beyond ordinary qualification branching-process limit theorems; their local estimates and coupling core are retained.
